description: Answer whether an actor (the bot, or a member) has a given permission, server-wide or in a channel, and explain the result through the role and overwrite chain. The answer is Discord's own permission check when Discord gives one, so it includes the implicit rules (a missing View Channel cancels what depends on it). For a member's whole permission list, use get_member_permissions; for everything a member can reach, get_member_access.

actor.description: A member name or ID, or "bot".

channel.description: Check in this channel instead of server-wide.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: explain_permissions
